description.value: A small, family-owned Chinese dessert shop in Richmond specializing in traditional soy pudding and fresh soy milk made daily in-store. The menu spans hot and cold tofu fa with extensive topping customization, classic Hong Kong sweets, and savory snacks including pot stickers, pan-fried turnip cake, and curry fish balls. Situated in a commercial plaza near Aberdeen SkyTrain station, it offers a distinctive rest-stop option for cyclists exploring Richmond's urban cycling network.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 41m; rack (8 spaces) at 73m; rack at 95m. Total: 8 spaces.
